assets.title: One-Metre Railway Infill Track
assets.description: Original one-metre railway half-length infill with two unscaled full-size timber sleepers and newly authored short rail stock. Y ports at plus/minus .50 m; clear head gauge 1.00 m, rail centres X plus/minus .54 m, head top Z=.20 m and sleeper pitch .50 m match the original 2m straight. Separate editable feet, webs, heads and sleepers; identity transforms, metres, Z up, underside-centre origin. Original 4mm head/foot end bevel and 8mm web retreat are retained: inset caps match, but paired running faces have a bevel notch and paired webs a 16mm gap. The original straight three-colour PBR palette is preserved. Intended for odd-metre static platform/turnout layout infill; no continuous train passage, wheel motion, load, engineering or railway safety certification.
